We follow previous works and adopt mean absolute error (MAE), Pearson correlation (Corr), seven-class classification accuracy (ACC-7), binary classification accuracy (ACC-2) and F1 score ... For MELD and IEMOCAP, we use accuracy (ACC) and weighted F1 (WF1) for evaluation.

For MOSI and MOSEI, we follow previous works  and adopt mean absolute error (MAE), Pearson correlation (Corr), seven-class classification accuracy (ACC-7), binary classification accuracy (ACC-2) and F1 score computed for positive/negative and non-negative/negative classification as evaluation metrics. For MELD and IEMOCAP, we use accuracy (ACC) and weighted F1 (WF1) for evaluation.
We randomly selected 80 samples with universal labels from MOSI and manually evaluated the generated labels used for universal label completion; the accuracy is about 90%.
